title: ALMA observation of an evolving magnetized corona in the radio-quiet changing-state active galactic nucleus NGC 1566
question: What is the origin of the mm continuum emission in the changing-state AGN NGC 1566, and how does it vary with X-ray flux and accretion state?

evidence.quote: The bolometric luminosity ($L_{\rm bol}$) was calculated using Eddington ratio ($\lambda_{\rm Edd}$) dependent bolometric correction factors ($\kappa_{\rm 14-195~keV}$) of (cite: Gupta2024).
The host galaxy flux was taken from (cite: Gupta2024).
The size of the X-ray corona ($R_{\rm X}$) is estimated to be $R_{\rm X}\sim 20-40$ $R_{\rm g}$ from the broadband X-ray spectral study of NGC 1566 (cite: AJ2021)

recipe.goal: Image ALMA continuum and measure fluxes
recipe.method: tclean images with all spws, per-spw images, peak flux; Gaussian 2D fit shows unresolved nucleus
Power-law fit to fluxes in four spws, F_nu ∝ nu^alpha

recipe.goal: Derive X-ray fluxes and bolometric luminosity
recipe.method: BAT/XRT rates converted to 14-150 keV; L_bol from lambda_Edd-dependent bolometric correction
Spearman correlation and linear fit in log space with intrinsic scatter

recipe.goal: Test origin scenarios and estimate source size and magnetic field
recipe.method: Order-of-magnitude estimates for SF, jet, outflow shock and self-absorbed synchrotron corona (equipartition)
assumptions: outflow velocity taken as escape velocity
